allowed_descriptive_derivations: count successful and failed starts per formula and seed family
report the lowest electronic screening energy among successful starts within the same formula
report all within-formula relative electronic energies without a significance threshold
report whether multiple starting families terminate at numerically identical coordinates only when equality is exact at stored precision
report final X-Y1, X-Y2, Y-Y distances and Y-X-Y angle
forbidden_v0_14a1_inferences: assign 3c4e or VDW electronic topology from geometry alone
claim a harmonic local minimum without a Hessian
claim a validated ground state from the lowest screening energy
introduce a post-result geometry-distance or energy threshold
reseed or rerun a failed formula with candidate-specific settings
remove a result because it conflicts with known chemistry
fit any PhaseNav/TIR descriptor to the molecular screening outputs
next_gate_condition: Only after the complete 9-formula/45-start raw execution is durably persisted may a separate v0.14B Hessian/local-minimum preregistration be designed. v0.14B must be frozen before Hessian results are read.
nonclaim: This readout contract is an interpretation guard, not a chemical model or validation result.
